units.rawText: You want to know what my dream is? To be a hero, of course. You want to know why I want to be a hero? You really are relentless, aren't you, Professor...

units.rawText: It's because I want everyone to be able to dream and keep believing in love and hope, and that a hero of justice will protect everyone.

units.rawText: So, my dream is—to protect other people's dreams! Ah, sorry... I got too worked up.
